schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: Edit the {protocol} schedule. Set active: true on exactly one entry. [More info]({scheduling_url})

error.invalid_schedule: Invalid schedule format. Check the schedule YAML structure. Location: {location}
error.no_active_entry: No entry is active for this protocol. Set active: true on one entry, or choose Off.
error.invalid_protocol: Schedule protocol must be h24 or ccs.
error.too_many_slots: Too many time slots in one group (CCS allows 3 per day group). Location: {location}
error.schedule_rejected: The stove rejected the schedule (unsupported protocol?). The previous schedule was kept.
error.invalid_temperature: Temperature values must be between 10.0 and 40.0. Location: {location}
error.invalid_time: Time values must be in HH:MM format with from before to. Location: {location}
error.invalid_day: Day names must be: mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun. Location: {location}
error.overlapping_slots: Time slots overlap on the same day. Location: {location}
error.schedule_send_failed: Failed to send schedule to module.
error.multiple_active: Only one schedule can be active at a time.
error.schedule_read_failed: Could not read the schedule from the stove. Showing the saved schedules, which may be outdated.
error.missing_key: A required key is missing. Location: {location}

options.off: Off – no schedule on the stove
options.h24: H24 – flexible: 3 temperatures over multiple time ranges (not all stoves)
options.ccs: CCS – simple on/off time slots, daily, weekly or weekend (all stoves)
